notes: Upper limits checked by `scripts/bench-tui.py gate`. Budgets are roughly 3x the baseline (2.5x for demo-scale memory), with floors of 1.0 s for first data and 1.0 % CPU (macOS ps CPU time has 10 ms resolution, about 0.1 % over 10 s) so that sub-second, near-idle values do not fail on noisy CI runners. Baselines: medians of 3 runs, 10 s idle window, 130x40 PTY. Re-measure with `scripts/bench-tui.py gate --repeat 3 --budgets scripts/bench-budgets.json` and update both fields together.
baseline_machine: Apple M2 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, KBorg 0.3.0 release build (14.7 MiB) of the working tree including KBORG_DEMO_SCALE
